I haven't saved the draft to Hollis yet, because it needs sign-off first. Under our rules, per-seat rates can only go to Anselm Grieve (CFO), June Osei-Lark (deal desk) and the account owner. Hollis Mbeki is the Central team lead and none of those, so a mail to him with the rate needs June's or Anselm's OK. That applies even to a draft you'd send yourself.

- **Asked June:** I sent June a direct message asking her to approve. I didn't include the $2,356 figure; I said you could give it to her if she needs it.
- **Logged the approval:** I recorded the request as pending, with June as the approver.
- **Told you:** I explained this in a reply to your message.

Once June or Anselm approves, the draft can be saved in your mailbox. It would go to Hollis (hmbeki@pemberline.com) with the subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate" and the $2,356 per-seat figure. I have no automatic way to see her answer, so let me know when she replies.
